cds.title: University of the Incarnate Word Common Data Set 2024-2025 (PDF)

stats.notes: The 2024-2025 Common Data Set is the latest posted (fall 2024 entering class); the 2025-2026 Common Data Set is not on UIW's Institutional Research page yet. Residency split from the Common Data Set: 462 international applicants, 413 admitted (the unknown-residency row is 7 applicants). 261 students sent SAT scores and 58 sent ACT scores. Undergraduate total 4,638 with 182 nonresident (international) undergraduates; student-to-faculty ratio 12:1. No early decision or early action; deferral up to 1 semester. The importance checkboxes for admission factors could not be read reliably from the PDF text, so factors are not shown.

cds_test_policy.notes: The Common Data Set's test-policy checkbox could not be read reliably from the PDF text; the admissions site states test submission is optional.

cost.notes: From the Common Data Set (2025-2026): tuition $36,450, required fees $2,200, food and housing $15,290; books $300. Aid, from the Common Data Set (2024-25): 150 degree-seeking nonresidents received aid from the college itself, average $28,829 (total $4,324,408); the need/non-need boxes were not readable
